name: Form Engine Room (Web)
implementation_notes: The Engine Room Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormEngineRoom.php, exactly mirroring FormStorageTank's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 27 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Engine Room has no computed detail-grid fields. 2 of them (Diesel Gen 1 Status, Diesel Gen 2 Status) render as <select> dropdowns with an empty '-- Pilih --' option (Run/Standby/Off)

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: both status dropdowns submit '' when left unselected; EngineRoomRecordService::normalizeDetails() (shared with screen-097) coerces this to null before validation/persistence, avoiding a SQLite CHECK constraint violation -- verified by dedicated unit tests and a Feature/Api test
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
Route /data/engine-room/create registered BEFORE /data/engine-room/{id} (screen-107) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormStorageTank's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveEngineRoomStationException (mirrors NoActiveStorageTankStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=engine-room

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): EngineRoomRecordService::create() memanggil assertPeriodOpenForWrite('engine-room', station->business_unit_id, date) setelah validasi & resolve station dan sebelum penulisan pertama; update() memanggilnya dua kali (tanggal lama record dan tanggal baru dari body) setelah findOrFail/cek akses/validasi — jadi memindahkan record keluar dari periode tertutup juga ditolak. Penolakan = PeriodClosedException 422 PERIOD_CLOSED dengan salah satu dari 4 pesan (belum ada periode / masih Draft / sudah ditutup / di luar rentang + rentang yang berlaku), nol baris tersimpan. FormEngineRoom::save() menangkap HttpException dan menampilkan pesannya sebagai alert halaman ($generalError). Test yang menutupnya: tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan + cek statis ke-18 service) dan tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php (end-to-end via Sterilizer); test per-layar (tests/Unit/Services/EngineRoomRecordServiceTest.php, tests/Feature/Api/FormEngineRoomTest.php, tests/Feature/Livewire/FormEngineRoomTest.php) membuka periode Terbuka sebagai prasyarat via openPeriodFor()/openPeriodForStation(). test_results tidak diubah (suite tidak dijalankan ulang untuk sinkronisasi ini).
